clauses.clause: Frames: `l4-plaza-safe` clean and alive; war frames read "huge mixed war"; player readable in the battle.
clauses.note: All151 current L4 physical captures inspected across low/high and both photo zooms. Pre-alarm reception is clean and populated, with separated civilians, lowered soldier rifles and no blood/fire damage. Battle frames contain a large horde, soldiers, armoured vehicles, helicopter, fire and corpse fields. Courier clothing/outline remains distinguishable when surrounded; living bodies can overlap the courier, but the inspected battle frames retain an identifiable player. P: PO: do the war frames read as a huge mixed war? Use the reviewed battle captures; player readability remains an objective inspection. This verdict closes objective inspected clauses only and does not answer that feel question.
